posts.title: Announcing pkgmirror: self-host your own Zig mirror
posts.description: pkgmirror is an open-source, self-hosted Zig toolchain and package mirror service so your builds no longer rely on third-party services or Microsoft GitHub. Mach now hosts its own pkgmirror at pkg.hexops.org .
